KMB_2010_p61__paragraph_2.ocr:
(a)
The expected return on plan assets is determined by multiplying the fair value of plan assets at the remeasurement date, typically the
prior year-end (adjusted for estimated current year cash benefit payments and contributions), by the expected long-term rate of return.
